```{r}
#Load libraries
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(dunn.test)
library(ggthemes)
library(ggtext)
library(tidyr)
library(markdown)

#Colors
color_palette <- c("Water" = "#949494", "3OMG" = "#7FC29B")
theme_set(theme_bw())

# Prepare base theme
base_theme <- theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(color = "white", fill = "white"),
    strip.text.x = element_markdown(size = 10, color = "black", hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size =11),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, color = "black", angle = 90, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 0.75))

#Set the levels of the experiment
Microbes_levels<-c("MF", "F16")

Treatment_levels<-c ("Water","3OMG")
labels <- c(
  'MF' = "Microbe free"
)
```

# A] Barplot stacked

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
#Load data
data_3OMG=read.csv("Experiments_on_plants_with_germination.csv", sep=";",h=T)

# Compute counts per Experiment, Treatment, and Disease.index
counts <- data_3OMG %>%
  group_by(Experiment, Treatment, Disease.index) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

#Stats if needed
# Make sure your data has columns: Treatment, Disease.index

# Create a contingency table: rows = Treatment, columns = Disease.index
table_data <- table(data_3OMG$Treatment, data_3OMG$Disease.index)

# View the table
print(table_data)

# Run Chi-squared test
chi_result <- chisq.test(table_data)

# View results
chi_result

# Extract p-value
chi_result$p.value

# Optional: view expected counts to check if Chi-sq assumptions are OK
chi_result$expected

# Fisher test with simulated p-value
fisher_result <- fisher.test(table_data, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 10000)
fisher_result
fisher_result$p.value

# Get all treatment combinations
treatments <- unique(data_3OMG$Treatment)
pairwise_results <- combn(treatments, 2, function(x) {
  # Subset data for the two treatments
  subset_table <- table(data_3OMG$Treatment[data_3OMG$Treatment %in% x],
                        data_3OMG$Disease.index[data_3OMG$Treatment %in% x])
  
  # Chi-squared test
  test <- chisq.test(subset_table)
  
  # Return results as a data frame
  data.frame(Treatment1 = x[1], 
             Treatment2 = x[2], 
             chi_stat = test$statistic, 
             p_value = test$p.value)
}, simplify = FALSE)

pairwise_results <- do.call(rbind, pairwise_results)
pairwise_results


#Order the conditions
data_3OMG$Treatment <- factor(data_3OMG$Treatment, levels = c("Control","Rhizoctonia", "Rhizoctonia+3-OMG"))

# Stacked bar plot
stacked_bar <- ggplot(data_3OMG, aes(x = Experiment, fill = factor(Disease.index))) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack", color = "black") +  # stacked bars
  geom_text(data = counts,
            aes(x = Experiment, y = n, label = n, group = Disease.index),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),  # middle of segments
            color = "black",
            size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~Treatment) +  # facet by Treatment
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("mediumseagreen", "goldenrod1","orange2",
                               "darkorange3","orangered3","red4")) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Biological replicates",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Disease index"
  ) +
  base_theme 

stacked_bar
```

# B] Histogramm

```{r}
library(ggpubr)
library (car)
library (ordinal)
library (RVAideMemoire)
library (emmeans)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(gridExtra)
library(multcomp)

data_3OMG=read.csv("Experiments_on_plants_with_germination.csv", sep=";",h=T)
data_3OMG$Experiment<-as.factor(data_3OMG$Experiment)

library(ggplot2)

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Compute counts per Disease.index and Treatment
counts <- data_3OMG %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Disease.index) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Plot histogram with counts on top
histo <- ggplot(data_3OMG, aes(x = factor(Disease.index), fill = factor(Disease.index))) +
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.8,
                 position = "identity",
                 stat = "count",  # count each occurrence
                 color = NA) +
  facet_grid(Treatment ~ .) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("mediumseagreen", "goldenrod1","orange2",
                               "darkorange3","orangered3","red4")) +
  # Add count labels
  geom_text(data = counts,
            aes(x = factor(Disease.index), y = n, label = n),
            vjust = -0.5,
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Disease index",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Disease index"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  ylim(0,190)

histo

```

# C] Reduced plots

## 1) Boxplot
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Calculate mean disease index per Experiment × Treatment
overall <- data_3OMG %>%
  group_by(Experiment, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(OverallDisease = mean(Disease.index), .groups = "drop")

library(ggpubr)

#Boxplot
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsignif)
library(dplyr)

# Example: pairwise comparisons
comparisons <- list(
  c("Control", "Rhizoctonia"),
  c("Control", "Rhizoctonia+3-OMG"),
  c("Rhizoctonia", "Rhizoctonia+3-OMG")
)


#T.test assumptions
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)   # for outlier detection, normality, variance tests
library(ggplot2)

# Check for outliers per Treatment
outliers_table <- overall %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  identify_outliers(OverallDisease)

outliers_table #No outliers

# Check normality per Treatment
normality_table <- overall %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    Shapiro_p = shapiro.test(OverallDisease)$p.value,
    Normal = ifelse(Shapiro_p > 0.05, "Yes", "No"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

normality_table #Two out of three normal

# Optional: Q-Q plots per treatment
qqplot <- ggplot(overall, aes(sample = OverallDisease)) +
  stat_qq() +
  stat_qq_line() +
  facet_wrap(~Treatment) +
  theme_bw() #ok exept control

# Check equality of variance (homoscedasticity) using Levene's test
levene_test <- overall %>%
  levene_test(OverallDisease ~ Treatment)

levene_test # no difference of variance


# Compute p-values for each comparison. I do a wilcoxon test because just 3 samples
pvals <- sapply(comparisons, function(comp) {
  data_sub <- overall %>% filter(Treatment %in% comp)
  test <- t.test(OverallDisease ~ Treatment, data = data_sub)
  p <- test$p.value
  if (p < 0.001) {
    "P < 0.001"
  } else if (p >= 0.05) {
    "ns"
  } else {
    paste0("P = ", signif(p, 2))
  }
})

# Define y positions for the bars
y_positions <- c(1.5, 2.5, 2)

# Count number of replicates per Treatment
n_reps <- overall %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("n=", n))

#Order the conditions
overall$Treatment <- factor(overall$Treatment, levels = c("Control","Rhizoctonia", "Rhizoctonia+3-OMG"))


# Create the boxplot with Wilcoxon stats
boxp <- ggplot(overall, aes(x =Treatment , y =  OverallDisease, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0, size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Treatment",
    y = "Overall Disease Index (mean per Experiment)",
    fill = "Treatment"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  geom_signif(
    comparisons = comparisons,
    annotations = pvals,
    test = "wilcox.test",
    y_position = y_positions,
    tip_length = 0.03,
    col = "black",
    size = 0.4
  ) +
  ylim(-0.2, 5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Control" = "darkgray", "Rhizoctonia" = "red4", "Rhizoctonia+3-OMG" = "#7FC29B")) +
  geom_text(data = n_reps, aes(x = Treatment, y = 3.5, label = label), size = 3) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Control"   = "Control (MF)", "Water_FSC"  = "Control (FSC)", "3OMG_FSC"   = "3OMG (FSC)"))


boxp
```

## 2) Barplot
```{r}
#Summarize data
overall_sum <- overall %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_OD = mean(OverallDisease, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_OD   = sd(OverallDisease, na.rm = TRUE),
    n       = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Define y positions for the bars
y_positions <- c(3.5, 4.5, 4)

#Add column for facet title
overall_sum$Disease.2 <- c("R. solani (Root rot, damping-off)")    

#Plot
barp_Sol <- ggplot(overall_sum, aes(x = Treatment, y = mean_OD, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.7, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_OD - sd_OD,ymax = mean_OD + sd_OD),width = 0.2) +
  # Raw data points
  geom_jitter(data = overall,aes(x = Treatment, y = OverallDisease), width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.7, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Treatment",
    y = "Disease Index",
    fill = "Treatment") +
  base_theme +
  geom_signif(
    comparisons = comparisons,
    annotations = pvals,
    test = "wilcox.test",
    y_position = y_positions,
    tip_length = 0.03,
    col = "black",
    size = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Control" = "darkgray", "Rhizoctonia" = "darkgray", "Rhizoctonia+3-OMG" = "#7FC29B"),
                    labels = c("Control"  = "Control (Water)", "Rhizoctonia" = "Control (FSC)", "Rhizoctonia+3-OMG"  = "3OMG (FSC)")) +
  geom_text(
    data = overall_sum,
    aes(x = Treatment, y = -0.2, label = paste0("n=", n)),
    size = 3,
    inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  facet_grid (~  Disease.2)+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Control"   = "Control (Water)", "Rhizoctonia"  = "Control (R. solani)", "Rhizoctonia+3-OMG"   = "3OMG (R. solani)")) +
  
  ylim(-0.2,5)


barp_Sol

```
